name: css_catch_slide
description: THE MID-FLIGHT CATCH, manager-slide flavour: no -azul-animation-out declared, so removing #sidebar starts the default spring slide (a manager exit under the node's reconciliation key). Remounting mid-slide claims the zombie AND RETARGETS the SAME in-flight animation home (Channel::retarget preserves velocity by design - the 'reverse of an animation' machinery), instead of minting a second spring: active must stay at 2 right after the catch (the retargeted sidebar + the card's move), never 3, and the emptied zombie reaps on the next tick.
